cards.dramatic_use: An almost-kiss becomes more intimate when Mara stops scanning for status and actually sees Jonah’s fatigue, restraint, and delight.
cards.evidence_or_dynamic: Chastity gathers the sexual drive and passions into whole-person love; it makes the other visible as a person rather than an object.
cards.source: Satisfied in God, VA Beach, Nov 2025 — Session 4 • mpc-74e7842c6f30540d8f5a-b000036 • [open source](https://player.vimeo.com/video/1063365119)
cards.title: Chastity integrates desire toward love

cards.dramatic_use: The prose lingers on hands, breath, fabric, and the beloved’s body precisely when the characters choose restraint.
cards.evidence_or_dynamic: Chastity is presented as a condition for perceiving sensual beauty clearly, not as a flight from beauty.
cards.title: Purity sharpens sensual perception

cards.dramatic_use: Jonah’s courtship is compelling because his attention increases Mara’s freedom and competence.
cards.evidence_or_dynamic: Unmarried attraction can become skilled care, honor, and fascination rather than pseudo-marital entitlement.
cards.title: Reverent fascination in singleness

cards.dramatic_use: Fulcrum students locate a hidden object through a calibration game; Mara experiences the reader as inside her mind.
cards.evidence_or_dynamic: Tiny tactile, postural, vocal, and visual signals can carry more information than participants consciously notice, producing feats that feel paranormal.
cards.title: Apparent telepathy from involuntary cues
cards.transformation: Use new tasks, composite researchers, and an adult fellowship. Preserve only the cue-channel mechanism and felt eeriness.

cards.dramatic_use: Mara silently changes the rules of a demonstration and watches an oracle become merely talented.
cards.evidence_or_dynamic: Performance can remain impressive until the relevant information channel is isolated; randomization and cue controls distinguish skill from story.
cards.title: Controls collapse the miracle
cards.transformation: Invent the protocol and result. Keep the epistemic turn: a mundane mechanism need not make the experience emotionally mundane.

cards.dramatic_use: Two teams watch the same interaction under opposite predictions and leave with incompatible but internally coherent stories.
cards.evidence_or_dynamic: Expectations about what will happen can act as an attentional lens, changing which threats, affordances, and interpretations become salient.
cards.title: Intention steers attention
cards.transformation: Use a fictional alignment exercise and let the divergence reshape alliances and romantic trust.
